C01, C02, C04, and C06 are the explicit THOUGHT Glyph Library Fifth Set. C01, C04, and C06 retain their promoted glyph paths and packed payloads; C02 includes the approved A crossbar, question-mark gap, smooth-rise and optically spaced lowercase-f, smooth digit-2, lowercase-k junction, vertically centered U+002D, and smooth uppercase-G lower-join revisions. Its f reaches the declared logical ascender at y=11 and is centered on x=1..7; its k lower arm begins at (3.18,3.82), the two-decimal approximation of the diagonal intersection; its U+002D centerline sits at y=5, halfway between baseline and cap height; and its uppercase G lower bowl joins the right stem with a shared vertical tangent. All retain the unchanged 10-unit advance.
